notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote. Variant 1 (c.2210T>G, p.Leu737Ter) is a known stop-gained variant classified Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic in ClinVar (VCV000533901, rs759242053), gnomAD AF ~7.9e-5, cited in the founding BUB1B-MVA paper (Hanks et al. 2004, PMID 15475955). Variant 2 (c.3006T>G, p.Asn1002Lys) is a novel missense absent from gnomAD, predicted deleterious (SIFT 0.01) and probably damaging (PolyPhen 0.997). Both are heterozygous in the proband; trans configuration is assumed (singleton WGS, no parental samples, no read-backed phasing at these positions) but not directly confirmed. BUB1B biallelic loss-of-function causes Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy type 1 / PCS syndrome (autosomal recessive), matching the proband's phenotype (rhabdomyosarcoma, IUGR/short stature, failure to thrive) and the reported parental recurrent miscarriages consistent with carrier parents. Confirmed as the only genome-wide HIGH-impact variant that is simultaneously rare, ClinVar pathogenic, and phenotype-matching (SnpEff GRCh38.86 genome-wide scan, ~1250 HIGH-impact PASS variants reviewed).

LZTR1 stop-gained, c.2243C>G p.Tyr748Ter (chr22:20996720 C>G, GRCh38). Heterozygous, gnomAD AF ~1.4e-6 (ultra-rare), ClinVar has pathogenic/likely-pathogenic entries. LZTR1 loss-of-function causes LZTR1-related Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant form) and schwannomatosis. Flagged because RASopathies (Noonan/Costello syndrome) are a recognized differential for rhabdomyosarcoma predisposition, so this is a plausible secondary/modifying finding, not proposed as the primary cause given BUB1B is a stronger, better-matched, and independently ClinVar-confirmed finding.

MAGI2 stop-gained, p.Gln180Ter (chr7:78158312 G>A, GRCh38). Heterozygous, absent from gnomAD. MAGI2 biallelic loss-of-function causes autosomal recessive nephrotic syndrome/FSGS. Only one damaged allele was found genome-wide (no second MAGI2 hit), so this is not causal on its own, but flagged given the proband's nephrocalcinosis/renal involvement in case a second allele (e.g. a non-coding or structural variant not captured by this SNV/indel scan) is found on follow-up.
